reason: The image-only reading was uncertain in the abbreviations, the cut and fold-damaged lines and some rubrics, and the print and Rein fixed the expansions, the chant boundaries and the lesson authors.
sources: Historia(e) novae, de spinea corona (Dillingen, 1584), pp. 5-13, MDZ bsb10173227 scans 9-17 (page images)
Vienna, ÖNB, Cod. 1799** (Rein, Cistercian antiphoner), ff. 228r-231r, De corona spinea, Cantus Database source 123667 (transcription only)
Bernardus Claraevallensis, Sermo in feria IV Hebdomadae sanctae, 8-9, PL 183, via Corpus Corporum
Augustinus, In Iohannis evangelium tractatus 116.1 (incipit, as named in the 1584 print)
text:
SOURCE-ASSISTED READING (stams-2026-10-30b), made with the Historia de spinea corona (Dillingen 1584), the Cantus Database transcription of Rein (A-Wn Cod. 1799**) and Bernard's sermon (PL 183) at hand. Reread on the native images by a research reader: canvas 0, column a lines 23-31, column b lines 1-10 and 23-32; canvas 1, column a lines 1-13 (and lines 14-28 for the Bernard lessons, checked against the first reading), column b lines 21-33. Canvas 0 column b lines 11-22 were read by a second research reader before opening the print; some words there were corrected only with the print in view. All other lines rest on the image-only first reading and are not given here. Expansions in ( ); [ ] lost, damaged or supplied; ? uncertain.

Images: https://fragmentarium.ms/loris/F-udt0/Stams_STA_Frg_216_01r.jpg (canvas 0) and https://fragmentarium.ms/loris/F-udt0/Stams_STA_Frg_216_01v.jpg (canvas 1), each 4912 x 7360. Regions x,y,width,height in native pixels. Canvas 0 precedes canvas 1.

Canvas 0, column a, region 650,4450,1350,1250 (end of nocturn I antiphons, lesson i):
[V. Exiit ihesus portan]s spinea(m) corona(m). Et purpureu(m) vestim(entum). [D]e (com)mentario b(eati) Ioh(ann)is ep(iscop)i. [Fla]gellauit ih(esu)m pylat(us) fortassis [eum absol]ue(re)? volens et mitigare iudai[cum zelum]. Studens e[um] eripere et usq(ue) [ad hoc si]stere v(er)sucia(m) illor(um). Ideo fla[gellauit] et fieri que facta sunt co[ncessit cla]mide(m) et corona(m) circu(m)pone[re ut eorum m]olliat ira(m). R. S[i] pylat(us)

Canvas 0, column b, region 1950,1550,1650,1300 (end of R. Si Pilatus, lesson ii):
homini salte(m) humiliato parceres o i(n)misericors. Popule iudeor(um) quis te pot[uerit] excusare. V. Si coronauit ad ignominia(m) ut regi cessares invidere deiecto o (con)tabescens p(o)p(u)le. ii [P]ropterea et ihesu(m) coronatu(m) eduxit adeo? pilat(us) ut conuiciu(m) q(uo)d a militib(us) factu(m) erat i(n) eu(m) videntes paru(m) respu(er)ent a passio(n)e et vomant venenu(m). No(n) sic tam(en) extincta e(st) illor(um) ira s(ed) clamaba(n)t crucifige crucifige eum. R.

Canvas 0, column b, lines 11-22, regions 1900,2800,1650,900 and 1900,3650,1650,950 (second research reader):
[E]greditur ih(esu)s portans spinea(m) corona(m) et purpureu(m) vestimentu(m). No(n)? ornat(ur) regali habitu q(ui) ad obp(ro)b(r)iu(m) coronat(ur). V. Onerosus e(st) enim honor deh[o]ne[stans] [fold-damaged line, unread]. [iii] [T]u vero n(on) solu(m) audi hec s(ed) in me(n)te habe[re] co(n)tinue [...] et angelorum videns contumelia(m) pacie(n)te(m) a militib(us) p(er) verba p(er) res et omnia ferente(m) silencio imitare p(er) omnia ipsa. R. [Q]uid ergo corona spinea cap(ut) i(n)clitu(m) p(re)me(n)s q(ui)d i(n)qua(m) si n(on) ad paciencia(m) nos i(n)vitat. Q(ui)a si i(n) viridi hec fiunt de arido q(ui)d fiet. V. Conspui n(on) respuit gena generosa s(ed) ignosci supplicat

Canvas 0, column b, region 1950,4500,1650,1300 (lesson iiii, R. Spinis):
q(uo)d implicat n(on) nosti. Q(uia) si. iiii [N]os aute(m) f(rat)res n(on) solu(m) legam(us) q(uod) pass(us) est xp(istu)s s(ed) et me(n)te feram(us) ea(m) corona(m) spinea(m) vestim(en)tu(m) calamu(m) alapas plagas exspuiciones yronia(m). Sufficiencia e(ni)m su(n)t h(ec) co(n)tinue revoluta ira(m) n(ost)ra(m) destruere. R. [S]pinis xp(istu)s coronat(us) f(actu)s e(st)? obp(ro)b(r)io torculari c(ruc)is p(re)ss(us) nos purgat a vicio. [...] V.

Canvas 1, column a, region 1550,1650,1550,1650 (verse of R. Spinis, nocturn II antiphons and versicle):
[V.] Spinis coronauit mat(er) i(m)pia auctore(m) vite q(ui) a(n)i(m)am dedit p(ro)pt(er) p(e)cc(a)ta mu(n)di. Morte. In ij n(octurno) a(n). [S]i merito i(n)vehim(ur) i(n) pilatu(m) q(u)alit(er) dissimulabim(us) de p(ri)ncipib(us) sac(er)dotu(m). ps D(eu)s i(n) no(m)i(n)e. a(n) Gens tua (et) po(n)tifices i(n)q(ui)t pylat(us) t(ra)dideru(n)t te m(ihi). ps Miserere m(ei) d(eu)s q(uonia)m c(onculcavit). a(n) No(n) h(ab)et legis lator adv(er)sarios sic(ut) legis doctores. ps Miserere m(ei) d(eu)s m(iserere). a(n) Lege(m) habe(re) se dicu(n)t s(e)c(un)du(m) qua(m) moriat(ur) q(ui) lege(m) venerat adimplere. ps Exaudi d(eu)s o(rationem) m(eam) c(um) d(eprecor). a(n) [Q]uib(us) quequa(m) n(on) lic(et) i(n)ficere? co(n)citant t(ur)ba(m) pet(er)e barraba(m). ps D(omi)ne d(eu)s s(alutis) m(ee). a(n) P(ro)pt(er)ea mai(us) pecc(atu)m h(ab)et q(ui) me t(ra)didit t(ibi). ps D(omi)n(u)s regnavit. V. Corona aurea sup(er) cap(ut) ei(us). Exp(re)ssa signo s(an)c(t)itatis.

Canvas 1, column a, lines 13-30 (Bernard lessons v-vi; first reading checked on the image, not reread in full):
S(er)mo beati B(er)nhardi Abb(at)is .v. [V]ide nu(n)c op(er)a d(omi)ni q(ue) posuit sup(er) t(er)ra(m). Flagellis ces(us) spinis coronat(us) clauis (con)foss(us) affix(us) patibulo obp(ro)b(r)iis saciat(us) omniu(m) tame(n) dolor(um) i(m)memor ait Ignosce illis. Hinc multe miserie corporis hic multe iniurie? cordis. R. [V]e corone sup(er)bie v(est)re ebrii effraym q(ui) cu(m) coronas v(est)ras mitte(re) debetis dicturi dign(us) es illudebatis ei dice(n)tes aue rabbi et dantes ei alapas. V. Cecidit corona capitis n(ost)ri? ve nobis q(ui)a peccauimus. Dice(ntes). [R]etribuentes mala p(ro) bonis fouea(m) vi fodiu(n)t s(ed) caritas n(on) irritat(ur) n(on) p(re)cipitat(ur) nu(m)q(ua)m excidit n(on) i(n) fouea(m) ruit. Et p(ro) retributis malis cumulat bona. Absit ut musce moriture exterminent suauitate(m) u(n)guenti q(uo)d de tuo corpore fluit. R. [S]i u(n)q(ua)m t(ibi) (con)traria i(n)tuli aut p(ro)sp(er)a denegaui q(ui) spoliasti me gl(ori)a mea et abstulisti corona(m) de capite meo. V. Cu(m) e(ss)et circa me corona

Canvas 1, column b, region 3100,4500,1200,1450 (end of nocturn II, nocturn III):
[V. Cum fecerit grande convivium ut] ostendat diuicias gl(or)ie regni sui. P(er)cip(iemus). [interlinear, small: q(ua)re sup(r)a ante ca(n)tica] [P]edib(us) (con)culcabit(ur). A(n). [N]equaq(ua)m [coronatus est ut] clareret i(m)p(er)io s(ed) ut obp(ro)b(r)io repleret(ur). [V. Circumdedit] me p(o)p(u)l(u)s iste. Spinis p(eccat)or(um) suor(um). [I]n illo t(empore) Ap(p)rehendit pylat(us) ih(esu)[m et fla]gellauit. Et milites plecte(n)t[es coronam] de spinis i(m)posueru(n)t capit[i eius et veste] p(ur)purea circu(m)dederu(n)t eu(m). Et r(eliqua). [C]u(m) iudei clamasse(n)t no[n ...] ih(esu)m sibi a pylato [...]
